newsitem.title: USA: All American Q3 sales to hurt results.
newsitem.headline: All American Q3 sales to hurt results.

text.p: All American Semiconductor Inc said on Monday that its third quarter sales of $57 million topped last year's third quarter sales of $47 million, but are below expectations and are expected to hurt earnings.
The company did not specify the impact it expects on earnings, and spokesmen were not immediately available to answer questions of provide further information.

Improved sales were from acquisitions and some sales improvements in certain territories, but weakened market conditions and price erosion in the semiconductors market hurt results, Bruce Goldberg, president and chief operating officer, said in a statement.
In last year's third quarter, All American Semiconductor reported earnings of $841,000, or $0.04 a fully diluted share.
For the nine month period ended September 30, sales exceeded $187 million, a 43 percent increase over sales of $131 million over the same period in 1995.
